evidence_state_definitions.PUBLIC_VERIFIED: Independent public source supports the claim.
evidence_state_definitions.REPOSITORY_VERIFIED: Objective repository/database state supports the claim.
evidence_state_definitions.PRIVATE_DOCUMENTED: A durable private document supports the claim; this is documentary evidence but not independent third-party verification.
evidence_state_definitions.HUMAN_ATTESTED: Claim is supported only by the completed human interrogation at this stage.
evidence_state_definitions.PARTIAL: Some components are documented but the full claim is not.
evidence_state_definitions.CONTRADICTED: Retrieved sources conflict; do not use the disputed detail externally until resolved.
evidence_state_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No supporting evidence was located in the retrieved surfaces.
